title: Add all new i18n string resources to strings.xml
description: Every user-facing string literal found across ui/ and notifications/ (full-file audit), deduped where the same text is reused verbatim across multiple call sites. Apostrophes are escaped as \' and the literal ampersand in the alarm-permission strings is escaped as &, since these are real Android string resources compiled by aapt, not just XML text.
acceptance_criteria: All 72 new <string> entries are added inside <resources>, after the existing app_name entry
No entry breaks XML well-formedness (ampersands escaped as &)
No entry breaks Android string-resource compilation (apostrophes escaped as \', embedded literal double quotes escaped as \")
Parameterized entries (dose_at_time, too_soon_warning_body, medication_name_dose, ai_import_summary, edit_item_content_desc, reminder_title, reminder_text) use numbered %1$s/%1$d placeholders
